user: Hi, I'm a freelance graphic designer and I opted for the 8% income tax rate.
response: As a freelance graphic designer opting for the 8% income tax rate, your tax will be based on your gross sales or receipts. However, since you are under the 8% regime, you cannot deduct business expenses. If your income comes purely from your freelance work, you can reduce your taxable amount by PHP 250,000 before applying the 8% rate. If your gross sales/receipts exceed PHP 3,000,000, you will need to switch to the graduated income tax rates instead [S2, S3].

Form 2307 is the Certificate of Creditable Tax Withheld at Source. It serves as proof that taxes have been withheld from payments made to a taxpayer, typically by clients or customers. This form is important for freelancers and professionals as it can be used to claim tax credits against their income tax liability when filing their returns [S3].
